tab.title: Names
tab.intro: Every name on your ledger, in its group — click one for its transactions. Edit a name to change its category or the bank descriptions it follows; it is saved for this ledger and every statement from now on. Drag a name onto another to merge them, onto a group chip above to move it there — or click its group tag — and drag a description onto another name; a sub-name dropped on a name can also move under it. A split rule picked for a name splits its transactions once; you can change those splits like any other.
